headline: AZ at home and second, but Twente's defence keeps the gap small
summary: AZ Alkmaar are at home and second in the Eredivisie, 3 points above 5th-placed Twente, yet the market rates them only 0.25 goals better. The reason is Twente's defence: 0.77 expected goals conceded per game across their last five. Twente's record signing Filip Thorvaldsen did not travel, Drimble reports. AZ needed a late goal to draw 2-2 at Cambuur on 18 October. Across the market, margin removed, AZ are 43.5% favourites; the goals line is 3.25, with over 47.5% and both teams scoring 66.2%.
read: AZ Alkmaar are at home and above Twente in the table, but the market only makes them a quarter-goal better and gives them a 43.5% chance of winning. Twente arrive with the stronger defensive numbers and a 66.2% both-teams-to-score line pointing to goals at both ends.

facts.fact: AZ Alkmaar are the market's favourites at 43.5% to win, with Twente on 31.3%.
facts.meaning: Home advantage and a higher league position make AZ favourites — but well short of a majority, so dropping points is the likelier single outcome than a comfortable home win.

facts.fact: The market's fair handicap line is AZ -0.25 goals.
facts.meaning: Essentially a coin flip with a quarter-goal of home advantage attached — the market does not see the second-versus-fifth gap as a real gulf.

facts.fact: Twente have conceded only 0.77 xG per game across their last five matches.
facts.meaning: Chance creation against them has been minimal, which is the single best argument for why this game is priced so close.

facts.fact: Twente sit fifth in the Eredivisie with 17 points from nine games.
facts.meaning: Three points behind AZ — so the narrow market split reflects a genuinely close matchup, not a mispriced one.

facts.fact: AZ were held 2-2 at Cambuur on 18 October, needing a late rescue to avoid defeat.
Twente's record signing Filip Thorvaldsen did not travel for the Conference League trip to Lincoln Red Imps because of injury, having first been ill.
facts.meaning: If he is still missing at AZ, Twente lose the most expensive attacking option in their squad for a game they are rated close to even in.

facts.fact: The market's goal line for this match is 3.25.
facts.meaning: A line above three goals says the market expects an open game with three or more goals in it, even though the Under is the marginally favoured side.

facts.fact: Both teams to score is priced at 66.2%, making it more likely than not.
facts.meaning: The market expects both defences to be beaten at least once, which sits a little awkwardly with how few chances Twente have conceded.

sources.fact: AZ Alkmaar are third in the Eredivisie and were held to a draw at Cambuur on October 18, dropping points just as PSV had the day before.
AZ needed a late rescue to escape defeat at SC Cambuur, drawing after having lost their previous league match.
AZ were beaten by Sunderland in the Europa League, according to a Sunderland fan photo feature recalling a narrow win over the Dutch Cup winners.
FC Twente's record signing Filip Thorvaldsen did not travel to Gibraltar for the Conference League match against Lincoln Red Imps because of injury, Dutch outlet Drimble reports.
Erik ten Hag is now technical director at FC Twente, and this week he criticised the state of Manchester United, according to the Manchester Evening News.
